text_blocks.snippet: Tips for Choosing the Right Whey Protein

list.snippet: Protein Type: Concentrate is suitable for daily use and general fitness; isolate is better for low-carb or cutting goals.
Flavor Preference: Flavored whey ensures easier mixing and consistent use. Unflavoured is versatile but requires additional ingredients for taste.
Serving Size & Price: 1kg packs under ₹2000 offer a good balance between affordability and duration of supply.
Brand Trust: Look for certifications and trusted brands to ensure product quality 3 .
Post-Workout: Mix 1–2 scoops with water or milk within 30 minutes of exercise to optimize recovery and muscle protein synthesis.
Daily Supplement: Use in smoothies, oatmeal, or breakfast shakes to ensure sufficient protein intake throughout the day 2 .
